fact: The December 2025 Terra Bénin baseline states that, apart from the public cadastre.bj portal, ANDF's digital land platforms (e-Foncier Bénin, e-Terre, e-Notaire) are not open to the general public and only approved providers (97 active of 267) can file requests, with transactions on the platform covering 226,028 parcels.
title: Evaluation de base du Programme Terra Bénin
